In the 2009 photos all domes/roofs are grey sheet metal.

verificationNotes: Places of worship mapped in Strâmtura village (OSM API bbox query): the Orthodox parish church (way 816480176 'Parohia Ortodoxă Strâmtura') and the new Greek-Catholic church Adormirea Maicii Domnului (way 816480175, yellow, with spire – Commons 'RO MM Stramtura 2' describes it as 'Biserica greco-catolică nouă'). The village also has the 17th-c. wooden church Sf. Arhangheli (Orthodox, shingle roof, historic monument), on which copper strip is implausible. No source found documenting the 2023 copper works; hram not found.

Bârsana commune has many churches: the Orthodox parish church in the village centre cemetery (node 3550657019, probable outline way 1306396916 ~526 m2), Greek-Catholic Sf. Ap. Petru și Pavel (node 825016351), Greek-Catholic Schimbarea la Față (node 13065251088), the UNESCO wooden church Intrarea în Biserică a Maicii Domnului (way 1306396753, shingle roof – copper implausible), the Bârsana Monastery complex (way 349144854, shingle roofs) and an Orthodox church in Nănești. With several plausible masonry churches and no source about a 2023 copper roof (web-search quota exhausted), the building is UNRESOLVED; town-centre coordinates kept.
